title: 454,000 displaced: Thousands sleep rough in Beirut as strike shelters overwhelmed
summary: As Israeli strikes continue in southern Lebanon, for many people there is nowhere left to go. Some are sleeping in cars, on the streets or on the beach. Hundreds of schools, places of worship, and stadiums have been turned into emergency shelters, but many more are needed. As soon as one opens, it fills up.
